title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch with Integrated Towel Bar, Wall Mount Solid Brass Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch with Integrated Towel Bar
description:
Add storage and hanging space with a 16-Inch glass shelf featuring an integrated towel bar for everyday bathroom organization. Built with 3/8-Inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass and solid brass hardware, this wall mount design keeps essentials within reach while saving floor space. Part of the Waverly Place Collection, it’s designed to coordinate with matching Waverly Place accessories for a cohesive, transitional bathroom look.

Highlights:
- 16 x 5-Inch glass shelf adds display and storage space
- Integrated towel bar keeps hand towels accessible
- 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges
- Solid brass hardware for a crafted, enduring feel
- Designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Category: Glass Shelves
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Projection: 5 Inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Style: Traditional (fits transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware)
